figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,product_id,unit_price_cents,contract_cents,unit_price_cents-contract_cents contract_variance_cents,previous_cents,ROUND(100.0*(unit_price_cents-previous_cents)/NULLIF(previous_cents,0),2) change_pct FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY po_item_id

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled')
parts.note: 先把名为 a 的中间结果算出来，供后面的查询引用。
